title: Prime Day Streaming Deals: Save Up to 93% on Apple TV, Paramount+, Starz and Other Services
summary: Amazon has popular add-on channels on sale during Prime Day — streaming deals expire on Friday (June 26).
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With Amazon’s annual Prime Day a few days away, beginning on Tuesday (June 23), the retail giant dropped a few deals early to get shoppers ready for the four-day event.

Right now, you can save up to a whopping 93% on all sorts of streaming channel add-ons for Prime Video. With prices starting at just $0.99 per month for two months, you can watch some of the best movies, TV shows and originals from popular streaming services, including Apple TV , Paramount+ , Starz and others.

Shop Prime Video Streaming CHannel deals on Amazon

PRIME DAY DEAL

Apple TV

Prime Video add-on streaming channel

$5.99/month $12.99/month 54% off

Buy Now on Prime Video

Expires: Friday, June 26

Paramount+

$0.99/month $13.99/month 93% off

With savings up to 93% for the Essential and Premium plans, Paramount+ is one of the best streaming services for originals, classics, and live news from CBS News. The service is to home to live sports from NFL, UEFA, PGA, WNBA, EFL, NWSL, all UFC events and other leagues. It also has original music programming, including Behind the Music ,  Willie Nelson & Family ,  The Carters: Hurts to Love You ,  How Music Got Free ,  Family Legacy ,  Lolla: The Story of Lollapalooza  and others. For Prime Day, Paramount+ is priced at $0.99 per month for two months .

Starz

$0.99/month $11.99/month 92% off

One of the best Prime Video add-on channels is Starz , especially with its Prime Day price of $0.99 per month for two months. Regularly, the streaming service goes for $11.99/month, so this deal saves you 92% off for a limited time. Starz is the home to original series, like Outlander , Power Book III: Raising Kanan , Power Book IV: Force , BMF , P-Valley , Hightown and others.

BritBox

$0.99/month $10.99/month 91% off

On sale for $0.99 per month for two months (regularly $10.99 per month), BritBox features a wide selection of movies and TV shows from the United Kingdom, including classics, like Doctor Who and Sherlock , as well as new favorites, like Riot Women and The Other Bennet Sister .

PBS Masterpiece

$0.99/month $6.99/month 86% off

PBS Masterpiece , which is on sale for $0.99 per month for two months, features cozy mysteries, like Grantchester , as well as notable classics, like The Count of Monte Cristo . Learn more about what PBS Masterpiece has to offer here .

ViX Premium

ViX Premium is the largest Spanish-language streaming service with originals, like Guardián de mi vida , Tan cerca de ti, nace el amor , Hermanas, Un Amor Compartido and others. It usually goes for $10.99 per month, but for Prime Day, ViX Premium is on sale for only $0.99 per month for two months. That’s a 91% savings.

Hallmark+

$0.99/month $7.99/month 88% off

Marked down to just $0.99 per month for two months of service (regularly $7.99 per month), Hallmark+ cozy romance originals, including Texas Two-Step , The Way Home , The Greek Aisle , Hope Valley 1874 and others. It’s on sale for nearly 90% off its usual price.

Acorn TV

$0.99/month $9.99/month 90% off

With originals and content from the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and other international markets, Acorn TV is best for those who want something more than U.S. movies and TV shows. For Prime Day, it’s on sale for only $0.99 per month for the two months of service (regularly $9.99 per month). Learn more about Acorn TV here .

BBC Select

For the history enthusiasts, BBC Select features a wide library of history documentaries and programming, and even some travel lifestyle content, from the United Kingdom. It’s on sale for $0.99 per month for the two months (regularly $6.99 per month), an 86% savings.

PBS Kids

$0.99/month $4.99/month 80% off

On sale for 80% off for Prime Day, PBS Kids features family-friendly programming, including Arthur , Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood , The Berenstain Bears , Mister Rogers’ Neighborhood , Reading Rainbow and more. The add-on channel is marked down to only $0.99 per month for two months (regularly $4.99 per month).

In addition, Wonder Project and Great American Pure Flix are on sale for $0.99 per month for two months (regularly $8.99 per month and $9.99 per month, respectively).

Meanwhile, Prime Video (as a standalone service) starts at $8.99 per month with an ad-supported plan. It comes with a 30-day free trial too .

All of the streaming service add-ons mentioned above are available within the Prime Video app, which is compatible on laptops (via web browsers), smartphones, tablets, streaming devices and all sorts of smart TVs.
